title: Your Body Does This Every Night 🤯
narration: You are taller in the morning than at night. The discs in your spine get squeezed during the day and stretch back while you sleep. Here's another one. An octopus has three hearts, and its blood is blue. And honey never spoils. Archaeologists have found honey in ancient Egyptian tombs that was still safe to eat. So which fact surprised you the most? Tell me in the comments.
caption: Which one did you already know? 👇
